# Stacked bar

```{r}
stackdatBW %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_replace(timepoint,
                                 pattern = "-",
                                 replacement = " ")) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("Pre Placebo", "Post Placebo", "Pre BRB", "Post BRB"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample, y = RelAbun, fill = Phylum)) +
  facet_row(vars(timepoint), scales = "free_x", space = "free", strip.position = "bottom") +
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "", y = "") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 19), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 24))
ggsave(file = "../figures/Fig2B-BRB-Placebo_stacked_bar.svg", width = 10, height = 4)
```

# BRB volcano plot

```{r}
volplot.in <- mic_fc_BW %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  right_join(model_res_BW) %>%
  mutate(tlev = str_sub(term,1,1),
         tlab = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, gsub("_", " ", gsub("\\w__", "", term)), NA))

volplot.in %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = l2fc, y = -log(p.value), color = tlev, label = tlab)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_text_repel(show.legend = F) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = 2, type = "qual",
                     breaks = c("k", "p", "c", "o", "f", "g", "s"),
                     labels = c("Kingdon", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),
                     name = "") +
  labs(x = "Log2FoldChange") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("../figures/volcano_bewell-mixed-effects.svg")
```

# BRB modelling LDA

```{r}
model_res_BW %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.08) %>%
  separate(term, into = c("TaxaLevel", "term"), sep = "__") %>%
  mutate(term = gsub("_", " ", term), 
          term = paste0("*", term, "*"),
         term = gsub("\\*Lachnospiraceae unclassified\\*", "Unclassified Lachnospiraceae", term),
         term = fct_reorder(term, estimate),
         ) %>%
ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = term, fill = TaxaLevel)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Effect Size", y = "") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2", breaks = c("f","g", "s"), name = "Taxonomic\nRank", labels = c("Family", "Genus", "Species")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)  +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_markdown(),
        legend.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

ggsave("../figures/effect-size_glm-binomial.png",
       height = 3, width = 4)
ggsave("../figures/effect-size_glm-binomial.svg",
       height = 3, width = 4)
```

```{r bootstrap pval for all sig being lachno}
sample.vec <- ifelse(allspecs.remtax %in% lachno.remtax, "Lachno", "Not Lachno")

set.seed(112358)
sample.seeds <- runif(10000, 1e4, 1e5)

lachno.draws <-vector()
for(i in sample.seeds){
  set.seed((i))
  pullspecs <- sample(sample.vec, 2, replace = F)
  res <- all(pullspecs == "Lachno")
  lachno.draws <- append(lachno.draws, res)
}

sum(lachno.draws)/length(lachno.draws)
```

# Respondersig Scatter Plot

```{r}
PLSDA_plot <- function(object,
                            batch = NULL, resp = NULL, hull = NULL,
                            xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL,
                            color.set = NULL,
                            batch.legend.title = 'Batch',
                            resp.legend.title = 'Response',
                            density.lwd = 0.2,
                            title = NULL, title.cex = 1.5,
                            legend.cex = 0.7, legend.title.cex = 0.75){
  
    data <- as.data.frame(object[['variates']][['X']]) 
    expl.var <- object[['prop_expl_var']][['X']]

    if(is.null(batch)){batch <- batch}else{batch <- as.factor(batch)}
    if(is.null(resp)){resp <- resp}else{resp <- as.factor(resp)}
    if(is.null(hull)){hull <- hull}else{hull <- as.factor(hull)}

    # color set
    if(is.null(color.set)){
        #color.set <- color.mixo(seq_len(10))
        color.set <- c('#D55E00','#999999', "red3", '#388ECC', '#F0E442', "purple4", "purple4", "burlywood3")  
    }else{
        color.set <- color.set
    }

    # main plot
    pMain <- ggplot(data = data, aes(x = data[ ,1], y = data[ ,2],
                                    color = resp, shape = batch)) +
        geom_point() + 
        xlab(paste0('PC1: ', round(as.numeric(expl.var[1])*100),
                                '% expl.var')) +
        ylab(paste0('PC2: ', round(as.numeric(expl.var[2])*100),
                    '% expl.var')) +
        scale_shape_manual(values = c(19, 0, 1, 2, 6, 4)) +
        scale_color_manual(values = color.set) + 
        stat_ellipse(aes(group = hull, color = hull), size = 0.2) +
        theme_bw() +
        labs(colour = resp.legend.title, shape = batch.legend.title) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim) + 
        scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim) +
        theme(legend.position = 'right', legend.box = 'horizontal',
            legend.direction = 'vertical',
            legend.key.height = unit(0.2, 'cm'),
            legend.key.width = unit(0.1, 'cm'),
            legend.title = element_text(size = rel(legend.title.cex)),
            legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, 'cm'),
            legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, 'cm'),
            legend.text = element_text(size = rel(legend.cex))) 
    
    xlim.update <- layer_scales(pMain)$x$get_limits()
    ylim.update <- layer_scales(pMain)$y$get_limits()

    # top density plot
    pTop <- ggplot(data = data, aes(x = data[ ,1], fill = resp,
                                    linetype = batch)) +
        geom_density(size = density.lwd, alpha = 0.5) + ylab('Density') +
        theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size = rel(0.8)),
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = rel(title.cex)),
            axis.line = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(), legend.position = 'none') +
        scale_fill_manual(values = color.set) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = xlim.update) + labs(title = title)

    # right density plot
    pRight <- ggplot(data = data, aes(x = data[ ,2],
                                    fill = resp, linetype = batch)) +
        geom_density(size = density.lwd, alpha = 0.5) +  coord_flip() +
        ylab('Density') +
        theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = rel(0.8)),
            axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(),
            axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(), legend.position = 'none') +
        scale_fill_manual(values = color.set) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = ylim.update)

    if(is.null(batch) && is.null(resp)){legend <-
        grid.rect(gp = gpar(col="white"))}else{
            legend <- get_legend(pMain)
        }

        grid.arrange(pTop, legend, pMain + theme(legend.position = 'none'),
                    pRight, ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                    widths = c(3, 1), heights = c(1, 3))

}

PLSDA_plot(object = bewellsig.pca[[1]], batch = bewellsig.pca[[2]], resp = bewellsig.pca[[3]], hull = bewellsig.pca[[4]])
```
